During fiscal year 2026, no Named Executive was awarded stock options, no Named Executives held any Microsoft stock options, and Microsoft did not time the disclosure of material nonpublic information or grants for the purpose of affecting the value of executive compensation. Equity Compensation Plan Information This table provides information about shares of Microsoft common stock that may be issued under our equity compensation plans approved by shareholders and plans not approved by shareholders (if any) as of June 30, 2026. Under the 2026, 2017, and 2001 Stock Plans, no option or stock appreciation rights may be repriced, replaced, regranted through cancellation, repurchased for cash or other consideration, or modified without shareholder approval (except in connection with a change in our capitalization) if the effect would be to reduce the exercise price for the shares underlying the award. Our employees prepare these reports for our directors and executive officers using information obtained from them and from Microsoft’s records. Due to an administrative error, Amy L. Coleman, Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer, was 16 days late in filing a Form 4 on October 3, 2025, to report the grant of a stock award for 4,358 shares. Due to broker initiated-transactions that occurred without his direction, approval, or knowledge, Bradford L. Smith, Vice Chair and President, filed a Form 4 on December 12, 2025, to report the acquisition of 3,842 shares of common stock on April 23, 2025, and the subsequent disposition of those shares on April 30, 2025 and May 5, 2025; Mr. Smith has paid the Company the full amount of profit realized in connection with these short-swing transactions. 2026 PROXY STATEMENT 63 Table of Contents 1 BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND GOVERNANCE 2 NAMED EXECUTIVE OFFICER COMPENSATION 3 AUDIT AND FINANCE COMMITTEE MATTERS 4 PROPOSALS TO BE VOTED ON DURING THE MEETING 5 INFORMATION ABOUT THE MEETING 3.
